newsitem.title: DUBAI: Jordan, Qatar condemn Jerusalem tunnel opening.
newsitem.headline: Jordan, Qatar condemn Jerusalem tunnel opening.

text.p: Jordan and Qatar on Thursday condemned Israel's opening of a tunnel in Jerusalem near Islam's third holiest mosque and held the Jewish state responsible for clashes in which 15 Palestinians have been killed.
The condemnation was voiced during talks in Doha between Jordan's King Hussein and Qatar's Emir Sheikh Hamad bin Khalifa al-Thani, the official Qatari news agency said.

It said the two leaders condemned Israel's opening of the tunnel as "a violation of the sanctity of the holy city and a provocation of the Arab and Moslem feelings and contradicts the principles of the peace accord".

They held Israel's government responsible for clashes between Palestinians and Israeli soldiers and asked Israel "to implement its pledges, especially agreements reached under the Middle East peace process".
